name: QuestMVGBalloon
rows: You are the "upgraded" Mecha Shiftys? That is hilarious.
I will show you. A difference in performance does not mean a difference in power!
Mission accomplished. I am Mecha Shifty.
... I must stop your character merchandise business.
Mega Mecha Shifty... Surrender, and I will forgive you this time.
Mekami Shifty gave me twice the power! Now, I am Mega Mecha Shifty x2!
Did you say x2? Everyone, please show your support for 2x2 Love.
Privaty as a teacher and Arcana as a student! Who will the Commander choose? The student or the teacher? 2x2 Love: a true campus romance simulation!
... This is why robots should never get overconfident.
Setting up a character merchandise business without me... I will not stand for it.
Only one left now: Mekami Shifty.
You've transformed... I didn't expect you to know such a technique. I certainly never taught it to you.
I made this body with a 3D printer. They can do amazing things these days.
Then make one for me too, one with special coating.
No! It won't sell. The character merchandise industry revolves around cute girls!
